name: Remote access
description: Starboard, Jellyfin and Audiobookshelf away from home through Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel, with no port opened on your router.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Connect with
settings.hint: Tailscale joins your phone to home privately. Cloudflare Tunnel gives a web address of your own, behind Cloudflare Access.

settings.label: Sign in with
settings.hint: With a link, the address to open shows in Addresses away from home.

settings.label: Tailscale auth key
settings.hint: Make one in your own Tailscale admin page, Settings, Keys. It starts with tskey-auth-.

settings.label: Name on your tailnet
settings.hint: Letters, numbers and hyphens, such as starboard.

settings.label: Cloudflare tunnel token
settings.hint: From Cloudflare's dashboard, Networks, Tunnels. Point each public hostname at http://localhost:8095, 8096 or 13378.

settings.label: Share Audiobookshelf
settings.hint: Shared only when Audiobookshelf is in Starboard's apps. Download apps are never shared.

added: **Tailscale** in userspace networking, with an auth key or a sign-in link
**Cloudflare Tunnel** with a tunnel token, stopped if a route leads anywhere but Starboard, Jellyfin or Audiobookshelf, or to Starboard without Cloudflare Access
**Addresses away from home** for each shared app, with Test; download apps are never shared
